source: Cambodia Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), presentation deck "ប្រព័ន្ធវប្បកម្មដំណាំស្រូវ តាមគោលការណ៍ធម្មជាតិ (ប.វ.ស)" [System of Rice Intensification Following Natural Principles (SRI)], undated PowerPoint presentation (no author, date, or elibrary URL visible on slides)
text:
Land preparation guidance under the System of Rice Intensification (SRI): the field should be plowed multiple times, to a depth of at least 15 cm, then harrowed to level the surface. The purposes of this thorough tillage are to: bury weeds and crop residue into the soil so they decompose into fertilizer; loosen the soil and improve root penetration/growth; make water management easier; and bury natural (organic) fertilizer into the soil to reduce nutrient loss while increasing air pore space in the soil.

For deepwater or rain-fed fields where water levels fluctuate (ស្រែច្រាំង / ស្រែប្រដេញទឹក), the field should be tilled before the field floods; after the water recedes, it is sufficient to simply harrow the soil to level it, without full replowing.
